products.description: Authoritative product catalog with monotonic version numbers for conflict & staleness detection.

orders.description: Document-based orders with embedded line items and unique clientOrderId idempotency key.

carts.description: Synchronized cart documents supporting operation-based delta updates and versioned snapshots.

wishlists.description: Synchronized wishlist product sets per client profile.

addresses.description: Cached delivery addresses used during offline checkout preparation.

devices.description: Registered synchronization client devices, checkpoints, and connection telemetry.

sync_operations.description: Idempotent processed operation ledger keyed uniquely by operationId.

sync_sessions.description: Audit trail of synchronization sessions, batch outcomes, latency, and byte transfer metrics.

sync_metadata.description: Global monotonic sync cursor and framework checkpoints.

conflicts.description: Policy-evaluated conflict records preserving local payload, server state, policy, and resolution history.

sync_events.description: Structured telemetry event stream feeding OfflineSync Monitor logs and SSE.
